name: F3b.10 with no request recorded, loke's /api/layermetrics says recorded false and the governance page says 'No requests recorded', with no figure shown
js: await (async()=>{const d=await (await fetch('/api/layermetrics',{cache:'no-store'})).json();await window.refreshLayerMetrics();const st=document.getElementById('lm-status');const body=document.getElementById('lm-body');const shown=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#lm-days tr,#lm-types tr')).length;return (d.measured===true&&d.recorded===false&&d.requests===0&&!st.hidden&&/^No requests recorded/.test(st.textContent)&&body.hidden&&shown===0&&document.getElementById('lm-requests').textContent===''&&document.getElementById('lm-agreement').textContent==='')||JSON.stringify({d,st:st.textContent,hidden:body.hidden,shown});})()
